The cleanest direct exposures are optical component leaders Coherent and Lumentum, but the underfollowed lane is more interesting around AXT as a relatively pure InP substrate supplier and Tower Semiconductor as a silicon-photonics foundry capacity proxy. This pass intentionally avoids overfilling with AI mega-cap customers and treats them only as demand-context anchors. Tower Semiconductor is a higher-cap silicon-photonics foundry-capacity candidate. MKS is a more indirect equipment/subsystem proxy into wafer fabrication and potentially photonics-related process capacity. Coherent is included as a reference anchor because it sits closer to lasers, optical materials, and transceiver demand, but it is not the main underfollowed target. Layer 1B expansion found a plausible two-lane universe around the upstream optical-interconnect bottleneck.
